title: Off The Books
tagline: Two dirty cops. One Klan house. No backup.
description: Dee and Don are brothers, adopted, and both dirty cops. The captain hands you the jobs off the books: gear up in your apartment, find the right house on a snowy street, take it apart, load the cash into the trunk and outrun every cruiser in town on the way home. Play it solo with your AI brother, together online, or head to head: one of you robs the house while the other one is the law.
features: Bodycam first-person gunplay with real bullet travel
Solo with an AI brother you command, or co-op online with a friend
Versus: one player robs the house, the other plays the cop sent to stop him
Car chases where you shoot back, get out, and get back in
Play on PlayStation or Xbox controller, or keyboard and mouse

minimum.gpu: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
minimum.storage: 30 GB free while installing (10 GB after)
